attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) sum_(r<=16) c_r(x_t) s_ti^r v_i, s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); c(x_t) = b + a*tanh(x_t W) per layer/head, W initially N(0, 0.0334077^2) per entry, a initially 0, b_r initially 1/r!; x_t is the activation after the block input RMSNorm, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero
